title: n8n Pricing 2026: Plans, Free Tier & Costs Explained
summary: n8n pricing structures vary significantly between managed cloud hosting and local deployments. Compare monthly expenses to select the best infrastructure.
body_markdown:
## The Real Cost of Self-Hosting n8n vs Cloud


### What the free self-hosted version excludes


When you self-host n8n through its Community edition, you get the core workflow engine but lose the administrative layer required for multi-user governance.


Access to the external authentication provider (LDAP/SAML) interface is restricted by the FairCode license. The execution engine remains identical to paid tiers, but you'll have to manually manage local credentials for every contributor.


You will not find environment variables management within the UI in this version. Because of this omission, you are forced to restart the entire Docker container to update sensitive keys for services like the GitHub version control API or the Stripe payment gateway.


### Using environment variables in n8n Community edition


This UI restriction is a specific limitation of the Community edition rather than a permanent barrier to secure variable usage. You can still reference keys defined in your Docker environment by using standard expressions within any node field.


By calling the environment object directly, you maintain security without needing a dedicated management interface. A practitioner simply uses the syntax to pull values like API tokens or database passwords directly into the workflow logic at runtime.


This approach ensures that sensitive data remains outside the workflow JSON itself. While the Enterprise self-hosted version provides full UI-based variable management, Community users are expected to manage these values via the CLI or a .env file.


### Hardware and maintenance overhead costs


Perceived savings of a free license are often offset by the operational burden of managing the underlying infrastructure and database persistence.


Running n8n on a virtual private server requires dedicated memory for the Node.js process and a robust PostgreSQL instance to prevent execution logs from bloating the disk.


While the Community edition is free to download, the Enterprise self-hosted version requires a paid license fee to n8n despite being hosted on your own hardware.

Unless you maintain a rigorous backup strategy for your internal database, a single disk failure can erase months of automation logic.


### n8n enterprise plan pricing and features


If you require network isolation or high-availability clusters to support mission-critical production traffic, enterprise licensing is the only path.


Deployments into private clouds or restricted subnets are enabled by the Enterprise tier's use of external worker nodes.


Air-gapped means full control, not a fraction. Activepieces provides the same list of enterprise features (including SSO, SCIM, custom RBAC, and secret managers) in its self-hosted air-gapped documentation as it does in its managed cloud.


Regulated organizations like MoneyGram and FundingSocieties run this edition in production today to maintain total data sovereignty without losing administrative governance.
